name: Brann Bronzebeard's Lost Letter
label: Quest
description: Brann Bronzebeard's Lost Letter: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If you're reading this, I'm either dead or soon to be dead. It's hard to say. Most of the crew is dead anyhow.
Found information about a Titan. Great battle between him and an Old God. Yes, a bona fide Old God. Found ancient tunnel leading to Ahn'Qiraj. Taking it.
Take this letter to my old camp. Make sure my monkey is getting adequate food, water, and hugs.
P.S. Watch out for crazy Old God worshipping night elf.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well this explains a lot. If you ever find a way into Ahn'Qiraj, keep an eye out for ol' Brann. I'm afraid that he'll be powerless without his monkey.
